title: A class of stochastic control problems with state constraints
summary: We obtain a probabilistic solution to linear-quadratic optimal control problems with state constraints. Given a closed set $\mathcal{D}\subseteq [0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^d$, a diffusion $X$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$ must be linearly controlled in order to keep the time-space process $(t,X_t)$ inside the set $\mathcal{C}:=([0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^d)\setminus\mathcal{D}$, while at the same time minimising an expected cost that depends on the state $(t,X_t)$ and is quadratic in the speed of the control exerted.
